newsitem.title: MEXICO: Vitro to issue $350 mln in senior notes.
newsitem.headline: Vitro to issue $350 mln in senior notes.

text.p: Mexican glass giant Vitro SA said on Tuesday that its Vicap financing subsidiary would issue up to $350 million in senior notes with maturities in 2002 and 2007.
"The proceeds from the sale of notes will be used to refinance mainly peso-denominated debt of Vitro and its subsidiaries," Vitro said in a news release.
The notes will be available to "certain qualified investors and overseas persons," Vitro said.

"The notes have not been registered under the U.S. Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and may not be offered or sold within the United States absent registration or an available exemption from such registration requirements," Vitro said.
Vitro produces mainly glass containers and flat glass but also automotive glass, glassware, plastic containers, aluminum cans and household goods.
The company reported a total of 17.493 billion pesos, about $2.2 billion, in debts as of the end of the first quarter of this year.
